title: Journey Plan on the big demo company - phone test
sub: Big company: 600 shops, 20 salesmen, 1,544 sales. Rows 1-2: the Android phone in the lab (Pixel 7, Chrome 124) running the live app's own production code. Row 3: a PC Chrome pretending to be an iPhone 13 opened from the home screen - the notch, the clock and the home bar are drawn on, so it is a simulation. Gold dashed box = something wrong.

items.cap: Open. Shops appear 1.8-2.2 s after the tap. Top: 36 shops visited today. Team box: 228 shops done. They should match - the demo data is wrong here, not the app.
AW pressed. Only his shops stay on the map, with his road.

marks.t: salesman row: under the DEMO bar

items.cap: Full map. It is 839 px tall on a 783 px screen, so the bottom keys lose their names. The salesman row is hidden under the DEMO bar.
Day Replay playing. Flags, road, timeline and keys all fit.
Find a shop while AW is pressed. The map flies to Toko Subur Baleendah, but only AW's shops are drawn: empty streets and no message.
